answer: The island cap is enforced at intake and raven exposes the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a mirror tag. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, as each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The deposit is 60 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
